body: Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me. **Testing project:** [test_volumetric_fog_blend.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23459673/test_volumetric_fog_blend.zip) The test project showcases volumetric fog with very low density (`0.001`), lights with high volumetric fog energy (`200.0`) and VoxelGI affecting a FogVolume with density `0.5`. 4.5.1.stable | `master` | This PR -|-|- | | In this example, the PR only makes a tiny visual difference compared to `master`. I've opened a documentation PR to go along with this change: - https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/pull/11457
